records.title: AlphaEval: Evaluating Agents in Production
records.reason: AlphaEval is a production-grounded benchmark of commercial agent tasks and evaluation methods; it measures product value/reliability and proposes no inference-efficiency method despite a kernel-generation citation.

records.title: Topology-Aware Reasoning over Incomplete Knowledge Graph with Graph-Based Soft Prompting
records.reason: Knowledge-graph QA with graph-based soft prompts targets answer grounding, not inference efficiency, despite speculative-decoding citation.

records.title: Record-Remix-Replay: Hierarchical GPU Kernel Optimization using Evolutionary Search
records.reason: Record-Remix-Replay combines LLM-guided source rewrites, record-replay and Bayesian optimization across GPU kernel/compiler/launch spaces. Scientific applications report faster search and up to 1.33x kernel speedup / 28.4% compute-time reduction, but target is HPC scientific code rather than LLM inference kernels; transfer is plausible but unverified.

records.title: LEADER: Learning Reliable Local-to-Global Correspondences for LiDAR Relocalization
records.reason: LiDAR relocalization is a robotics/vision application, not language-model inference.

records.title: Harnessing Photonics for Machine Intelligence [Feature]
records.reason: Photonics feature article surveys accelerator possibilities but offers no concrete evaluated LLM inference method.
